title: Implement atomic Companion DecisionRecords and workflow effects

gates.name: decision_task_bus_regression
gates.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend/access_admin tests/backend/agent_chat tests/backend/task_follow_up tests/backend/companion_governance -m "not real_model" -q

evidence_required: Boss, granted Engineer, Consultant deny, current grant, wrong-Farm, archive, restore, stale proposal/version, and no-existence-leak decision matrix evidence.
All five effects plus action/unknown/mismatched-classification rejection, identical/conflicting request, concurrent decision, and pending-v1 to flushed-approved-v2 same-UoW Task-source evidence.
Same-transaction DecisionRecord/ordinary Task/state/UI/Bus/Timeline success and injected Task/projection/audit/database rollback evidence, including every reachable nested TASK_* translation.
Resolved/close lifecycle, focused and unfocused open conclusions, exact ApprovedGovernanceSummaryV1 context, rejected no-Bus, UI identity, and Timeline cardinality/redaction evidence.

HTTP/OpenAPI/no-store evidence for the exact DecisionRecord/close/result/conclusion fields, refs, nullability, ordering, and complete reachable Task/runtime/domain error mapping, plus advanced Safety Gate, Task Follow-Up, and older exact-head regressions proving FT-008 strict variants and FT-012 ordinary-task/Safety boundaries remain valid.
purpose: Complete the binding human-governance outcome over TASK-041 authority after TASK-040 has finished the shared Task Follow-Up package: authorized approve/reject and close commands, immutable DecisionRecords, exact atomic safe workflow effects, and guarded human/agent/audit projections without provider or physical-action authority.
success_outcome: Boss or a currently granted Engineer can approve or reject only the current pending proposal, choose keep_open or resolved, and later close only a resolved issue; approval atomically records the exact discussion_only, check, measurement, follow_up, or none effect and creates one same-kind governance_decision ordinary Task only when operative, rejection records none and publishes no Bus fact, and every stale, invalid, unauthorized, archived, Task, projection, audit, or persistence failure leaves the proposal/attention/issue unchanged with no partial DecisionRecord or effect.
anti_goals: Do not invoke a model, expose the explicit run command, compose providers, or perform credentialed UAT; TASK-043 owns that outcome.

Do not register the Companion router in backend/app/main.py; TASK-043 owns the single production registration after TASK-040, while this wave verifies decision/close routes through an isolated test app.
Do not redesign TASK-041 IssueStack/focus/attention/proposal identity or add another proposal persistence path.
Do not add a governance permission, reuse plant_approve_actions, forbid self-approval, add expiry/reopen/hard delete, or persist CompanionConclusion.
Do not create action Tasks, approve physical action, mutate Plant state, complete Tasks, record Outcomes, perform device work, or add frontend/PWA/scheduler/worker/outbox behavior.

forbidden_scope: TASK-043 Companion request/result, provider composition, external egress, explicit run endpoint, or credentialed smoke.
A second IssueStack/proposal store, public proposal-create command, or changes to TASK-041 focus/attention/supersede identity except a narrowly proven compatibility repair.
New permission flags, plant_approve_actions governance semantics, self-approval restrictions, Farm-level governance, expiry, reopen, or hard delete.
Safety approval, action Task, Plant-state confirmation, Task completion, Outcome, target values, device commands, automated actuation, frontend/PWA, scheduler, worker, or outbox.
stop_conditions: TASK-041 aggregate/proposal implementation differs materially from the linked lifecycle, record-version, or current-proposal contract.
The implemented TASK-039 ordinary-task service cannot accept governance_decision inside the caller's SQLAlchemy Session/UoW without widening Safety or action authority.
DecisionRecord, operative ordinary Task, proposal/attention/issue transition, required UI/Bus projections, and Timeline refs cannot be one PostgreSQL transaction.
Approved-only DecisionRecord context cannot be resolved from PostgreSQL without raw proposal/rationale/UI content or mutable replay authority.
Existing uncommitted work makes the decision-effect migration or shared Task/Agent Chat/API/writer edits unsafe to reconcile.

constraints: Decision and close commands allow only Boss or currently granted Engineer with can_operate=true; Consultant and archived/unauthorized scope fail closed with no new permission or self-approval rule.

Only the current pending proposal at expected_version=1 and its active attention may decide, whether its open issue is focused or unfocused; keep_open focuses the target and atomically clears a different focus, resolved leaves another issue's focus unchanged, close is a separate resolved-to-closed command, and terminal records are immutable.
Effects are exactly discussion_only, check, measurement, follow_up, and none; approval copies the proposal effect, rejection forces none, and action/unknown/mismatch rejects the whole decision.

Operative DecisionRecord, the proposal locked pending-v1 then flushed approved-v2 for that same record, same-kind governance_decision ordinary Task, state transitions, required Timeline refs, decision/proposal UI, and approved-only Bus row commit together or all roll back; no intermediate commit or failed/no_effect DecisionRecord is retained.

Approved discussion_only/none may publish a compact DecisionRecord Bus fact without a Task; rejection creates human history only and no Bus fact; all agent context is the exact non-persisted ApprovedGovernanceSummaryV1 and safety_gate_authority remains not_granted.
The second FT-013 migration adds only decision-effect Task/Bus compatibility after the TASK-041 aggregate head and preserves every earlier row/variant.
Every exact-head assertion present after TASK-041, including Safety Gate and Task Follow-Up migration-model tests, advances to the decision-effect revision in this task.
The decision/close router is verified through an isolated FastAPI test app and remains unregistered in backend/app/main.py until TASK-043 performs the single production registration after TASK-040.
TASK-042 starts only after TASK-040 because both may edit backend/app/task_follow_up/; this explicit edge serializes the shared package even though their feature-local wave labels are both W2.
invariants: PostgreSQL is DecisionRecord, issue transition, and Task authority; Timeline, UI Feed, Bus, MessageEnvelope, classification, and conclusion cannot independently create, repair, replay, or transition records.
DecisionRecord never grants Safety approval, action Task, Plant-state mutation, device effect, Task completion, or Outcome authority.

Agent Chat Bus resolves only exact ApprovedGovernanceSummaryV1 facts from committed approved DecisionRecords; UI projections and mutable CompanionConclusion/focus/attention are not Bus context. TASK-043 may separately assemble strict typed governance provider input.
Archive retains all governance rows and authorized reads but blocks decisions, close, workflow effects, and Bus publication; restore never replays denied work.

Identical decision/close retries return the first canonical result; stale versions, reused identities with different fingerprints, superseded/terminal proposals, and projection conflicts have no effect.
verification_targets: Migration/model tests prove the decision-effect revision follows TASK-041, adds exact Task source/Bus constraints and nullable backend-domain scope, and advances Safety Gate, Task Follow-Up, and every older exact-head assertion without changing earlier rows.

PostgreSQL service/concurrency tests prove approve/reject, attention satisfaction, focused/unfocused open conclusion reads, keep_open focus transfer, resolved/close, identical duplicate versus conflict, current authority, and archive/grant/stale races.

Effect tests cover all five allowed values, action/unknown/mismatch rejection, one same-kind governance_decision Task from the flushed approved-v2/same-DecisionRecord graph without intermediate commit, committed duplicate, wrong proposal phase/link rejection, discussion_only/none no Task, rejection none/no Bus, and zero Safety/action/Plant/device authority.

Failure injection proves Task insert, Timeline append, UI/Bus projection, and database errors roll back DecisionRecord plus every state/effect mutation while non-authoritative appended audit noise cannot replay state.

Projection/context tests prove exact decision/proposal UI updates, approved-only DecisionRecord Bus identity, canonical companion_issue/companion_attention/companion_proposal/decision_record refs and source arrays, exact ApprovedGovernanceSummaryV1 reconstruction/omission, complete focused/unfocused conclusion latest/nullability matrix, null scope only for backend domain records, and zero raw proposal/rationale leakage.

Isolated-router HTTP/OpenAPI and focused FT-008/FT-012 regressions prove exact DecisionRecord/close/result/conclusion fields, refs, ordering, nullability and all six reachable TASK_* translations plus impossible-code fallback, no-store/no-leak, retained archive reads, and unchanged ordinary-task/Safety/context boundaries without touching production main.py.
